stem.en: Why did the recipe cause a problem for Malika?

options.en: It said 'two cups' of water but not how big a cup was.
It gave the flour in grams, but she had no kitchen scale.
It did not say that the water had to be warm.
It did not have any yeast in it, so the dough did not rise.

why.en: The recipe asked for 'two cups of warm water'. Malika used a big tea mug, but her grandmother meant her small blue cup, so 'two cups' was not clear. Malika did weigh the flour on the scale, and the recipe does say warm water and yeast.
why.uz: Retseptda 'ikki piyola iliq suv' deyilgan. Malika katta choy krujkasini ishlatdi, buvisi esa oʻzining kichkina koʻk piyolasini nazarda tutgan edi, demak 'ikki piyola' aniq emas edi. Unni Malika tarozida tortgan, retseptda iliq suv va xamirturush ham bor.
why.ru: В рецепте было «две чашки тёплой воды». Малика взяла большую кружку, а бабушка имела в виду свою маленькую синюю чашку, так что «две чашки» было неточно. Муку Малика взвесила на весах, а тёплая вода и дрожжи в рецепте указаны.
